exposure: never breastfed in an exclusive way
weaning after the 4th month of age
outcome: Composition of infant gut microbiota at 12 months of age
Alpha and beta diversity of gut microbiota
Impact of prenatal, perinatal, and postnatal factors on gut microbiota composition
cohort: 45 infants enrolled in the A.MA.MI. study (NCT04122612)
finding: While prenatal and perinatal factors did not significantly impact gut microbiota composition at 12 months, postnatal factors like milk feeding type and weaning time showed the most substantial influence.
mod_finding: Delivery mode was not found to be a significant factor influencing the composition of infant gut microbiota at 12 months of age.
